---
title: "easyTSA: Trial Sequential Analysis from a meta object"
output: html_document
---

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}
if (!requireNamespace("easyTSA", quietly = TRUE)) {
  remotes::install_github("vanioljantunes/easyTSA")
}
pacman::p_load(meta, readxl, rstudioapi, ggplot2)
library(easyTSA)
```

```{r import data}
# choose file (binary sheet: author, year, event.e, n.e, event.c, n.c)
# press Cancel to use the bundled example (atb_peecs)
myfile <- if (interactive()) tryCatch(selectFile(caption = "choose data"),
                                      error = function(e) NULL) else NULL

if (is.null(myfile) || !nzchar(myfile)) {
  data(atb_peecs, package = "easyTSA")
  data <- atb_peecs
  mwd <- getwd()
} else {
  # takes directory of the file
  mwd <- dirname(myfile)

  # take sheet names from excel file selected
  sheet_names <- excel_sheets(myfile)

  # create a list called ma where the data sets will be saved and named according sheet names
  ma <- lapply(sheet_names, function(x) {as.data.frame(read_excel(myfile, sheet = x))})

  # name the objects inside the list with the sheet names
  names(ma) <- sheet_names

  data <- ma$A_peecs
  if ("include" %in% names(data)) data <- data[as.logical(data$include), ]
  data <- data[!is.na(data$event.e) & !is.na(data$event.c), ]
}

data$studlab <- paste(data$author, data$year)
```

```{r meta-analysis}
outcome.name <- "Post-ESD electrocoagulation syndrome"
intervention.name <- "ATB"
control.name <- "No ATB"

m <- metabin(event.e, n.e, event.c, n.c, studlab = studlab, data = data,
             sm = "RR", method = "MH", method.tau = "REML",
             random = TRUE, common = FALSE)
m
```

```{r tsa}
# defaults: 5% two-sided conventional boundary, O'Brien-Fleming alpha-spending
# boundary on the sample-size axis, 80% power, anticipated effect from the
# weight-averaged arm proportions of the meta output, RIS corrected by D2
x <- tsa_create(m,
                label.e = intervention.name, label.c = control.name,
                title = outcome.name,
                outcome = "negative")   # event is a harm: RR < 1 favours ATB
x
summary(x)

# same, with a clinically anticipated effect instead of the empirical one
x30 <- tsa_create(m, rrr = 0.30, control = 0.12,
                  label.e = intervention.name, label.c = control.name,
                  title = outcome.name)
x30
```

```{r plots}
# tsa plot, empirical effect
png(paste0(mwd, "/tsa_empirical.png"), width = 2400, height = 1500, res = 250)
print(tsa_plot(x, show_labels = TRUE))
dev.off()

# tsa plot, RRR 30%
png(paste0(mwd, "/tsa_rrr30.png"), width = 2400, height = 1500, res = 250)
print(tsa_plot(x30, show_labels = TRUE))
dev.off()

# adjust appearance: ggplot object, add layers as usual
p <- tsa_plot(x,
              subtitle = NULL,
              show_favours = FALSE,
              col_z = "black", col_bound = "firebrick",
              ylim = c(-6, 6)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
print(p)
```

```{r tsa file}
# file for the Copenhagen Trial Unit TSA program (File > Open in the program)
tsa_write(x, paste0(mwd, "/tsa_empirical.TSA"))
tsa_write(x30, paste0(mwd, "/tsa_rrr30.TSA"))

# to launch the program from R, install TSA from https://ctu.dk/tsa/ and:
# Sys.setenv(TSA_HOME = "C:/path/to/TSA 0.9.5.10 Beta")
# tsa_launch(x)
```
